channel.title: Prism – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prism – Bias and Credibility (prismreports.org)

item.title: Arab Mother’s Day opens fresh wounds in Gaza amid the genocide
item.description: Celebrating the typically joyful holiday feels impossible when countless children have lost their mothers, and many mothers are left without their children or families

item.title: After Brooklyn Navy Yard ousts Israeli drone maker, activists want ICE contractor evicted too
item.description: Crye Precision, which provides tactical gear to federal immigration agents, continues to operate at the Brooklyn Navy Yard

item.title: Education Department was ordered to roll back its anti-DEI efforts. Why haven’t universities reversed course?
item.description: Last month, the department conceded it could not make universities’ race-conscious efforts illegal, but schools nationwide have yet to reinstate DEI efforts

item.title: South Florida organizers await ruling in gerrymandering lawsuit aiming to recognize Latinx community diversity
item.description: At the center of Cubanos Pa’Lante v. Florida House of Representatives are accusations that lawmakers drew districts by linking disparate neighborhoods, splitting established communities, and treating Latinx voters as a single political bloc

item.title: César Chávez’s shadow
item.description: Revelations that César Chávez sexually abused young girls and women has set off a bomb in Latino communities and movement spaces

item.title: Contaminated water from California prison sickens residents of nearby town
item.description: Ione residents say state and local agencies have refused to take accountability for elevated cancer rates and other health issues linked to water contamination at Mule Creek State Prison

item.title: The theft of bodily autonomy is central to the authoritarian playbook, and Texas has been its proving ground
item.description: Texas houses the country’s only family detention centers and has one of the highest maternal mortality rates in the U.S., but it is also home to powerful reproductive justice and migrant rights movements

item.title: A world without grief
item.description: Those who force AI and violence on our countries don’t recognize the beauty of the Earth anymore. They can neither feel the suffering of others, nor can they contemplate grief; they want a world without it

item.title: How Gaza’s cash-flow crisis impacts daily life
item.description: The lack of small bills means that vendors don’t have change and customers don’t have exact amounts. Meanwhile, electronic payment systems and intermediaries take large commissions

item.title: Israel is still targeting journalists in Gaza during the ceasefire
item.description: Radio Qatar correspondent Amal Al-Shamali was killed in an Israeli strike targeting tents sheltering displaced civilians, bringing the total journalist deaths in Gaza to at least 261

item.title: Buffalo’s Rohingya community demands answers in death of disabled refugee
item.description: Border Patrol agents left the nearly blind Nurul Amin Shah Alam in downtown Buffalo on a cold winter night. Days later, he was found dead

item.title: One bite at a time: the rules, regulations, and worries of parole
item.description: Each day of life on parole is carefully mapped out, and each decision starts with an exhausting mental checklist

item.title: Toddlers evacuated from Gaza as premature babies reunite with families
item.description: Eleven children returned to Gaza on March 30, after being evacuated during Israel’s two-week siege on Al-Shifa Hospital in November 2023

item.title: ICE presence at airports unlawfully restricts mobility of noncitizens, advocates say
item.description: Some immigrants and U.S. citizens of color have canceled travel plans as immigration agents review IDs alongside TSA agents at some airports

item.title: Israel institutes death penalty only for Palestinians
item.description: The new law mandates execution for Palestinians convicted in notorious military courts of killing Israelis in “acts of terrorism”
